_comment: Terra config FelixPilotSVLimited (workflow FelixPilot). Limited covariates, chr22, SEPARATE-FILE MODE (no joint_vcf). phase_vcf = the genotypes: flare_lai_prod.gt_vcf, the full phased chr22 callset with SNVs, indels and SVs. Its header records `bcftools view --output-type z` of the ligated BCF with no filter flags, so it holds exactly the ligated callset's records in VCF form; it is also the file the production FLARE run read, so haplotype order matches flare_vcf by construction. flare_vcf = the ancestry: the production chr22 FLARE anc VCF (AN1/AN2 at panel sites only; no SVs, and it is never the genotype source). felixla Pack matches each phase record to its covering FLARE marker itself, so no propagate step is needed. joint_vcf is intentionally absent: it is the single-file alternative that fills both roles, and it is what limited the earlier pilot to 165k marker sites. Every other input equals the FelixPilotLimited config, so MakeGRM and FitFelixNull should call-cache (enable call caching). pack_memory_gb is 64 as a hedge for the larger variant set.
